Switched the three call sites: managerPin.ts recordPinFailure ('self_approval' -> 'manager_pin_failed'), and in pos/service.ts createPosOrder the discount flag ('comp_above_threshold' -> 'discount_above_cap') and the price-override flag ('high_value_void' -> 'price_override'). metadata.realKind is kept on the PIN and discount flags so older readers still work. trustops POST /petty-cash/movements, top-up over the box limit: verifyManagerPin now gets the actor (req.staffUser.id) and action 'petty_cash_topup'. A PIN that is sent but doesn't verify (wrong, or another company's manager) now gets 403 INVALID_MANAGER_PIN; no PIN still gets 403 TOPUP_OVER_LIMIT. Wrong PINs are audited against the sender and count toward the PIN limit.

hr/attendance.ts recordPunch 'in': when the rota cell kind is 'leave', the new record's remark is 'Punched in on an approved leave day'. The rota is looked up per company, so a leave record in company A never marks a company-B day (tested).

review.title: Staff meal at the admin till always needs a manager PIN, but the tender has no PIN box; the error asks for a PIN the cashier cannot enter
review.scenario: compOrder in backend pos/service.ts (around line 2050) says every staff meal needs a manager at any amount. A cashier with no approver role sends no PIN, so the server answers 403 MANAGER_OVERRIDE_REQUIRED ('Manager PIN required for a staff meal'). In PaymentModal the Manager PIN input only shows when method === 'comp' (around line 621). The staff_meal block (around line 563) has only the 'Staff member' field. The error line (around line 636) then shows 'This comp is above your limit — enter a manager PIN and try again.', but the screen has no box to enter it. The only way through is to switch to Comp, type the PIN, and switch back, because the hidden managerPin state is still sent (line 202). If that hidden PIN is wrong, the cashier sees 'That PIN is not right' with no visible field, and each try counts toward their 5-per-15-minute actor lock. So on onboarding day a cashier cannot ring up a staff meal from the admin till. This gap existed before this stream, but item 9 covers this file's till PIN prompts and this error text.
review.fix: Show the Manager PIN input when method is 'comp' or 'staff_meal' (for staff_meal, label it 'Manager PIN (every staff meal needs a manager)' and hide it when the signed-in user is an override approver). For staff_meal, MANAGER_OVERRIDE_REQUIRED should read 'A staff meal needs a manager — enter a manager’s PIN.', not the comp 'above your limit' text. Clear managerPin in pickMethod when the tender changes, so a PIN typed under one tender is never sent hidden under another.

review.title: Refund retry loop asks for a third PIN and never sends it
review.scenario: refundThroughEngine loops for attempt 0..2, and each catch shows window.prompt. Attempt 0 (no PIN) gets MANAGER_OVERRIDE_REQUIRED and prompts for PIN 1. Attempt 1 (PIN 1 wrong) gets INVALID_MANAGER_PIN and prompts 'That PIN is not right. Manager PIN:'. Attempt 2 (PIN 2 wrong) prompts again. The manager then types the correct PIN, but the loop has ended and throws Error('Manager PIN not accepted') without sending it. The refund fails with a message that wrongly implies the right PIN was rejected. The loop existed before this stream, but this stream reworded its re-prompt and says the loop is handled.
review.fix: Make the loop limit one more than the prompt count, or stop prompting on the last iteration: for example, `for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 4; attempt++)`, or do not prompt when attempt === 2 and rethrow err, so refundErrorMessage shows WRONG_PIN_MESSAGE.

I checked all three findings and they are all real. I fixed IF-RV-1 and IF-RV-2 in the files I own. IF-RV-3 is a stale test file that belongs to another stream, so I handed it off without changing it.

- **IF-RV-1 (staff meal at the admin till):** Confirmed. Backend `compOrder` (pos/service.ts around line 2052) asks for a manager PIN on every staff meal unless the user is an override approver. PaymentModal only showed a PIN box under Comp, and its error text talked about the comp limit. Changes in `PaymentModal.tsx`:
  - The Staff meal tender now has a "Manager PIN (every staff meal needs a manager)" box. It is hidden when the signed-in user is an override approver, using the existing `useIsManager()` from managerRole.ts, which reads the server's approver list.
  - `pickMethod` clears the PIN when the tender changes.
  - A PIN is only sent when its box is visible on the current tender, so a hidden PIN can no longer be sent or count toward the cashier's 5-per-15-minute lock.
  - For a staff meal, `MANAGER_OVERRIDE_REQUIRED` now reads "A staff meal needs a manager — enter a manager’s PIN."
  - The two rules (when to show the box, and the error wording) are now small functions in pinErrors.ts, `tenderNeedsPinBox` and `compOverrideMessage`, so they can be tested.
  - I also changed the Staff member placeholder from "Name or employee code" to "Employee code". The server (pos/routes.ts around line 443) only matches an employee code or a user id, so typing a name always failed.
- **IF-RV-2 (refund retry loop):** Confirmed. The loop showed a third PIN prompt and then ended without sending that PIN. In `refundThroughEngine` it now runs `REFUND_PIN_PROMPTS` (3) prompts plus one more request, so every PIN typed is sent. After the last prompt it throws the server's own refusal, so `refundErrorMessage` shows `WRONG_PIN_MESSAGE` instead of the misleading "Manager PIN not accepted". A 429 lock-out still stops asking straight away.
- **IF-RV-3 (resimTill.test.ts):** Confirmed by reading the code: managerPin.ts writes `manager_pin_failed`, pos/service.ts writes `discount_above_cap` for the discount flag, and the test still queries `self_approval` (lines 131, 155, 168, 242) and expects `comp_above_threshold` (line 349). I did not run that suite. The fix is listed under needsOtherFiles.
